_comment: Cards for tests/unit/costs/test_remove_counters_x.py. `t_rcx_slagheap` is Molten Slagheap as printed: a {C} tap, a storage-counter tap, and '{1}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}', the mana ability that reads X. `t_rcx_engine` puts the cost on an ability that uses the stack, so the X the effect reads is visible on a life total. `t_rcx_hourglass` is Hourglass of the Lost's second ability, whose effect reads X in a graveyard selector. `t_rcx_refinery` is Moxite Refinery's cost -- X counters of any kinds off one artifact or creature you control -- on a life-gain effect.
